positions.title: Front-End Web Developer
positions.description:
• Led programming in the front-end of custom websites to solve client difficulties by improving desired performance metrics.
• Advised as to which technologies and frameworks were used in programming projects on a case-by-case basis.
• Technologies and frameworks frequently used included HTML, CSS/ SASS, JavaScript, WordPress, GSAP, WordPress, and PHP.
• Strategized new art direction and programming procedures to streamline collaboration and expedite digital deliverables.
positions.insights: Skills: WordPress · SASS · HTML · JavaScript · GreenSock Animation Platform (GSAP) · Git

positions.title: Front-End Web Developer
positions.description:
• Managed the design and function of the non-profit’s WordPress site that accommodated 500+ weekly users.
• Built webpages using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript together with X Theme to provide user-friendly functionality.
• Implemented and monitored donation plugins and crowdfunding platforms, gathering over $90K in 2017.
• Collaborated with board directors in the art direction of marketing materials to use online and in print distribution.
positions.insights: Skills: WordPress · Adobe Creative Suite · HTML · JavaScript · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Front-End Web Developer / Graphic Designer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed the company website using HTML, SASS, and jQuery.
• Worked with SEO Consultant to enhance site performance, which boosted page visits by 56%.
• Devised a full strategy on how website will solve client problems that included following a prompt schedule of deliverables.
positions.insights: Skills: Adobe Creative Suite · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · jQuery
